description: Perfect for Trade shows and business staysTeam trips, Families and groups of friends.Beautiful fully renovated house (2024), modern, bright, and fully air-conditioned, located just a 10-minute walk from Paris Expo Porte de Versailles.Up to 10 guestsSpacious and comfortablePrivate quiet gardenFurnished terraceBarbecue4 comfortable bedroomsClose to metro L13& L12 Easy access to central Paris & versaillesRare garden near ParisA quiet and independent cat lives in the house.The spaceThe Space:This modern 140 m² home, spread over three levels, was fully renovated in 2024 and features air conditioning in every room. Bright, spacious, and fully equipped, it offers a quiet and green setting, ideal for relaxing or working efficiently after a trade show, business trip, or day of sightseeing.The house offers 4 bedrooms • 7 separate beds • 2 bathrooms • 2 water closet •and high-speed fiber internet throughout. Outside, the enclosed garden is filled with trees and flowers and includes:• A furnished terrace• A large outdoor dining
